paragraphs: R' Chanina son of Atel — Esther Rabbah, section “Uchemelot.”[^1]

notes.text: אס״ר is expanded as Esther Rabbah. The section is named by its opening word וכמלאת, retained here as Uchemelot with conventional vowels rather than a verified pronunciation. Earlier machine OCR had ובמלא. No section number or named-edition verification is added; the abbreviated title remains R'.
